text: 国家发改委、国家能源局印发《“十五五”新型储能实施方案》。方案提出，加大新型储能产业支持力度。引导民营企业与高校、科研院所等协同创新，支持民营企业参与新型储能领域科技重大专项评选和投资新型储能。用好新型政策性金融工具、制造业中长期贷款、地方政府专项债券等，支持符合条件的新型储能项目建设。鼓励金融机构加大对新型储能的绿色金融支持力度。
text_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration issued the "15th Five-Year Plan" Implementation Plan for New-Type Energy Storage. The plan proposes to increase support for the new-type energy storage industry. It calls for guiding private enterprises to collaborate on innovation with universities and research institutes, and supporting private enterprises in participating in major science and technology programs in the new-type energy storage field and in investing in new-type energy storage. It calls for making good use of new policy-based financial instruments, medium- and long-term loans for manufacturing, and local government special bonds to support the construction of qualifying new-type energy storage projects. It encourages financial institutions to increase green finance support for new-type energy storage.
